name: UGC NET Commerce Exam Booster - Practice Test 2

questions.question: Which accounting concept states that a business will continue to operate indefinitely?
questions.hint: The going concern assumption assumes the firm will not liquidate in the foreseeable future.

questions.question: The difference between total assets and total liabilities is known as:
What is the primary function of marketing management?
options: Satisfying customer needs and creating value
questions.hint: Modern marketing focuses on identifying and delivering customer satisfaction.

questions.question: Under which market structure is there a single seller of a product with no close substitutes?
questions.hint: A monopoly has total market power with a single supplier.

questions.question: Which index is primarily used to measure the change in average price level of consumer goods?
questions.hint: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) tracks household cost changes.

questions.question: What does WTO stand for in global trade?
questions.hint: WTO is the global body regulating rules of trade between nations.

questions.question: The process of attracting suitable candidates to apply for a vacancy is called:
questions.hint: Recruitment is positive search for prospective employees; selection is filtering them.

questions.question: Which institution regulates the monetary policy and credit controls in India?
questions.hint: The RBI administers interest rates, repo rates, and reserves to control liquidity.

questions.question: The formula for break-even point in units is:
questions.hint: Break-even point occurs when total contribution equals total fixed costs.

questions.question: What is the main objective of corporate financial management?
questions.hint: Wealth maximization (market price of shares) is the primary goal.

questions.question: Which theory explains international trade based on differences in opportunity costs?
questions.hint: David Ricardo proposed comparative advantage based on relative efficiency ratios.

questions.question: What is the maximum number of partners in a general partnership firm under Companies Rules 2014?
questions.hint: The limit is set at 50 partners for general partnerships.

questions.question: Which audit is conducted continuously throughout the financial year at regular intervals?
questions.hint: Continuous audits help in immediate detection of accounting errors.

questions.question: What is the base slab structure of GST (Goods and Services Tax) in India?
questions.hint: GST India divides products into 4 active brackets plus exempt items.

questions.question: The concept of the "Double Entry System" of bookkeeping was first published by:
questions.hint: Luca Pacioli published Summa de Arithmetica in Venice in 1494.
